title: Remediate @sevenpico/cdk-construct-s3-bucket (PR #36 merged as stub)
description:
PR #36 was merged while both Code Review AND QA had CHANGES REQUESTED. The committed code is a TODO stub — not a real implementation. PR #42 (fix(s3-bucket): add comprehensive pure function tests) is currently in the PR pipeline addressing this, but the full implementation must be verified end-to-end.

Original issues:
- s3-bucket-fns.ts: single TODO stub, no real pure functions
- s3-bucket.ts: skeleton with no AWS resources created
- PR description falsely claimed '16 tests passing' — actual tests were stubs

What needs to be done:
1. Verify PR #42 (feat/cdk-construct-s3-bucket branch) contains a FULL implementation — not just more tests on top of a stub
2. If PR #42 is still incomplete, fully implement per spec/construct-s3-bucket.md:
   - All pure functions: s3BucketName, s3BucketProps, corsRules, lifecycleRules, etc.
   - Full S3Bucket construct: versioning, SSE encryption, public access blocking, lifecycle, CORS, replication, object lock, bucket policies
   - lambda-function-types.ts equivalent (s3-bucket-types.ts) with all JSII-safe props
   - Comprehensive BDD tests covering all spec scenarios
3. Run type check AND tests — both must pass
4. PR #42 must go through the full review pipeline (code review + QA + merge gate)

Note: PR #42 is currently at 🟣 (code review passed, QA in progress).
